card.name: Drug transporter names and linking words
card.fires_on: Words and punctuation inside or right after drug-transporter mentions (P-gp, BCRP, OATP, MRP2, efflux transporter) in interaction text. It also fires on 'ven-ous' in 'hepatic venous pressure'.

modes.label: Linker after transporter
modes.description: A small linking word or bracket right after a transporter name, before the next transporter or example is listed.
modes.example: Colchicine is a P-gp<< and>> CYP3A4 substrate.

modes.label: The word transporter
modes.description: The word transporter after hepatic efflux or uptake.
modes.example: B1 and the hepatic efflux<< transporter>> MRP2.

modes.label: Hepatic venous
modes.description: The ending of venous in a liver blood-pressure phrase.
modes.example: increased hepatic ven<<ous>> pressure gradient by 4 mmHg
